description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2640007267640 VALVE,PNEUMATIC TIR: Line 0001 Qty 789 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0046 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
